website_summary.name: BandHub Entertainment Directory
website_summary.description: The website has a sleek design with a floral white background and dark goldenrod components, facilitating an organized layout for band and advertiser interactions.
website_summary.appearance: The website features a professional design with a floral white (`#FFFAF0`) background and dark goldenrod (`#8B4513`) text and elements, ensuring a visually pleasing user experience. It is divided into three main sections: a left-side menu for navigation with options like "Sign Up," "Bands," and "Advertisers," a central login section where users can choose their role as either a "Band" or an "Advertiser" and then log in with their credentials, and a right-side placeholder for advertisements. Elements are well-aligned, and the login form contains labeled fields for role selection, username, and password input, along with a submit button for logging in.
website_summary.functionality: The website includes a menu for user navigation, enabling users to either sign up for a new account or login if they already have one. It provides specific user roles for bands and advertisers, each with personalized features such as submitting band information, audio samples, video links, and advertisements. Additionally, users can browse through乐队信息，包括音频样本和视频。
